transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. It's nice to meet you, too. 

Well, I suppose what made me come in today is that my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I completely forget to have lunch. And then other days, I'll just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets... even though nothing really tastes right to me anymore.
Have you noticed that your sense of taste has changed or become weaker?

No, I don't think my actual sense of taste has changed or gotten weaker. I mean, things still taste the way they always have. It's just... well, I just don't get any enjoyment out of eating right now. But my taste buds themselves seem to be working fine.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yes, I have. Most mornings, I just... I wake up with this heavy, low feeling. It's like the color has completely gone out of the day before I even manage to get dressed. So, yes, I've been feeling pretty down.
Have you also been finding that things you usually enjoy no longer feel pleasurable?

Yes, that's exactly it. I used to really look forward to my watercolor class, and the quilting circle... even my book club. But lately, I'll pack up my things, leave the bag by the door, and then I just... I just can't make myself care enough to actually go. It all just feels like too much effort for something I don't even enjoy anymore.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

I wouldn't say I have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. I'm not going to do anything. But... I do find myself thinking sometimes that if I just didn't wake up one morning, it might be a relief. To me, and probably to everyone else, too. It just feels like it would be easier.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?

Yes, I think so. My body just feels... slowed down lately. It seems like it takes me twice as long just to cross the living room, or even to button my sweater in the mornings. But then, on the other hand, sometimes I catch myself just pacing around the house, walking back and forth holding the same stack of papers in my hand without really doing anything with them. So, yes, my movements have definitely been a bit off.
Have you ever had a period like this before, when you felt depressed and lost interest in things for days or weeks at a time?
No, I don't think so. I've had sad days, of course, like anyone my age, but nothing quite like this... nothing that has lasted this long or made me feel so empty inside. This is new for me.
Have you lost weight recently without trying to?

I haven't really been on a scale to check my weight, but... well, that's actually a big part of what made me come in. My eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I completely forget to eat lunch, and then other days I'll just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets... even though nothing really tastes right anymore.
How long have you been feeling this depressed nearly every day?
Well, let me think... it's been quite a while now. I'd say this low, colorless stretch has been with me for about a year and two months.
Has this depression made it impossible for you to keep up with your usual daily responsibilities?

Well, yes, it really has. I used to teach craft classes, but I've stopped doing that entirely. I just don't have it in me. And... I've been missing phone calls, forgetting appointments, and just letting family tasks slip—things I always used to handle so carefully. I'm still managing to stay in my own home, but I find myself relying a lot more on reminders for everything. I just put off things that used to be a normal part of my routine.
